title: Ankrd1 as a potential biomarker for the transition from acute kidney injury to chronic kidney disease.
authors: Li, Hailin; Hu, Lemei; Zheng, Changqing; Kong, Ying; Liang, Ming; Li, Quhuan
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单核RNA测序和机器学习识别急性肾损伤向慢性肾病转变的潜在生物标志物Ankrd1，属于纯转录组表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模及AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) is one of the leading causes of acute kidney injury (AKI), predisposing patients to chronic kidney disease (CKD) due to maladaptive renal repair. Nevertheless, the molecular mechanisms and biomarkers that cause maladaptive repair remain unclear. In this study, we used single-nucleus RNA sequencing data from GEO database (GSE139107) to identify molecular markers during the transition from AKI to CKD caused by IRI. Analysis of intercellular crosstalk, trajectory and machine learning algorithms revealed hub cell clusters and genes. Proximal tubule (PT) cells, especially a new cluster (New PT2), significantly interacted with fibroblasts during the transition. The expression levels of hub genes were validated using the bulk RNA-seq data (GSE98622) and further confirmed through RT-qPCR and immunohistochemical analysis in ischemia-reperfusion injury (uIRI) mice. Ankrd1, a hub gene in New PT2, showed sustained upregulation in the proximal tubule in AKI. Compared to the sham-operated group, the expression of Ankrd1 in mice increased at 0.5 days post-reperfusion, peaked at day 1, and remained significantly elevated up to 60 days. This study indicated that the upregulation of Ankrd1 was positively associated with the progression from AKI to CKD and may potentially serve as a valuable biomarker for this transitional process.
abstract_zh: 缺血-再灌注损伤（IRI）是急性肾损伤（AKI）的主要原因之一，由于适应不良性肾脏修复，使患者易发展为慢性肾脏病（CKD）。然而，导致适应不良性修复的分子机制和生物标志物仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们利用GEO数据库（GSE139107）中的单核RNA测序数据，识别由IRI引起的AKI向CKD转变过程中的分子标志物。通过细胞间通讯、轨迹和机器学习算法的分析，揭示了核心细胞簇和基因。近端小管（PT）细胞，特别是新簇（New PT2），在此转变过程中与成纤维细胞显著相互作用。核心基因的表达水平通过批量RNA测序数据（GSE98622）进行验证，并在缺血-再灌注损伤（uIRI）小鼠中通过RT-qPCR和免疫组织化学分析进一步确认。Ankrd1作为New PT2中的核心基因，在AKI中近端小管内表现出持续上调。与假手术组相比，小鼠中Ankrd1的表达在再灌注后0.5天增加，在第1天达到峰值，并持续显著升高至60天。本研究表明，Ankrd1的上调与AKI向CKD的进展呈正相关，并可能作为这一转变过程的有价值生物标志物。
